ideas.title: Uncovering the Minnesota Government Fraud Scandal
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Minnesota government fraud scandal, including the extent of the fraud and those responsible.
questions: What is the extent of the Minnesota government fraud scandal?
Who is responsible for the scandal?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scandal and hold those responsible accountable. It requires a thorough investigation and analysis of financial records and government documents.
